== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Major Bren Derlin (Japanese)|Major Bren Derlin]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/152940003/ZeSnxgf8s0yGBwf0FwTSuQ.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 86099778.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>6aae4323b575e9482fcf2a1b4c1456d3ece73083b6bfd0c531ef1aa17045e065</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
